I will keep my land in the usual winter wheat and summer maize rotation. In Quzhou County, that is the most reliable way for me to use the whole year, match the local weather, and spread my risk. At the start of this season, my winter wheat is already in the field from last autumn, so I will focus on managing that first with fertilizer, watering, and disease control, then I will harvest it and plant summer maize right after. I will use improved seed because I want steady yield and better resistance, not the highest-cost option. I will not make the plan too complicated because I have to manage it with my own labor and what I can afford. For tillage, I will use rotary tillage before maize after wheat harvest because it is practical and fast for my conditions. I will use moderate fertilizer, irrigate a few key times, and spray only when needed, because I want dependable output more than taking big chances.
